description.fun: Grubbin is a burrowing grub with jaws strong enough to snap thick branches, so even the birds that hunt it think twice. It shoots sticky threads from its mouth to swing about like a stunt actor on wires and to tie up foes. It loves electricity and hangs around power plants and Electric Pokémon, which also keep birds away. With its two prongs, it looks a lot like an electric plug.
description.guide: Grubbin is a Bug-type larva Pokémon from Alola that lives underground and digs with its strong jaws. It shoots sticky thread to swing around and to trap foes, and it is drawn to sources of electricity. It evolves into Charjabug and then Vikavolt.
description.tagline: A grub that swings on threads and loves a power socket

description.fun: Charjabug is a living battery: digesting the soil it munches makes electricity, and it stores enough in its body to power a home for a whole day, which makes it a welcome guest on camping trips. It zaps anyone who steps on it, and Vikavolt carries it between its legs as a spare battery. It even gives off sparks in its sleep while it digests.
description.guide: Charjabug is a Bug- and Electric-type Pokémon, the middle stage of Grubbin's line, resembling a battery. It generates and stores electricity by digesting humus and can share its charge with other Pokémon. Vikavolt uses it as an extra power source in battle.
description.tagline: A boxy bug battery that could power your house

description.fun: Vikavolt is a flying railgun: an organ in its abdomen makes electricity, and it focuses it through its huge jaws into beams that knock birds out of the sky. With a Charjabug clasped in its legs as a battery it fires even faster, though it drops its passenger for agile dogfights. It weaves through tangled branches at high speed and can even keep flying while it sleeps.
description.guide: Vikavolt is a Bug- and Electric-type Pokémon, the final form of Grubbin, based on a stag beetle and a railgun. It fires electric beams from its jaws and is a fast, agile flier. A Totem Vikavolt guards Sophocles's trial in Sun and Moon.
description.tagline: A stag beetle railgun, with a Charjabug for a battery

otherWays: Level up, at Vast Poni Canyon or Blush Mountain

note.text: In Sun and Moon, Charjabug could only evolve by levelling up in a special magnetic field; later games also let a Thunder Stone do it.
